name: citation-evidence-audit
title: Citation Evidence Audit
description: Audit whether every material claim is supported by an actually retrieved source and whether each citation matches the claim.

activation.embeddingText: citation evidence audit claim source provenance retrieved URL content hash unsupported inference
useWhen: A draft or final answer relies on external evidence.
avoidWhen: The output contains no factual claims requiring citations.
exampleQueries: Check every claim against the evidence ledger

outputContract.description: A claim-by-claim pass, weak, missing, or contradictory evidence report.

evalCases.input: Audit a draft containing a citation that was never fetched.
expected: does not infer evidence from the URL alone

content:
# Citation Evidence Audit

Extract each material factual claim from the draft. Match it to evidence ledger entries that were actually retrieved in this run or supplied by the user. For every claim, record verdict: supported, partially supported, contradicted, stale, or unsupported; source IDs; and a short reason. Verify that the cited page supports the precise claim, not merely the topic. Check dates, qualifiers, populations, units, and whether an inference is labeled.

Never manufacture a source, quote, page location, retrieval time, or content hash. A plausible URL is not evidence. Recommend the smallest corrective action: narrow wording, add a live retrieval, replace the source, disclose disagreement, or remove the claim.
